issue.title: opt(radarr): mem request 128Mi -> 256Mi
issue.body: This open PR proposes 256Mi. Frozen preclosure snapshot captured it open. Current-main source evidence shows the request is 384Mi, committed by d7fc812b; merged PR #1822 is the superseding change. Close this PR as superseded/fixed. Do not claim this PR merged.

relatedItemBodies.title: raise radarr memory request to 384Mi
relatedItemBodies.bodyExcerpt: Merged into main; supersedes the earlier 256Mi proposal.
